questions.explanation: Lagrange identity: \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2-(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2=16\cdot9-(10)^2=44\).

questions.prompt: Find the position vector of the centroid of the triangle with vertices \(A(4, -5, 5)\), \(B(5, -2, 2)\), \(C(3, 4, -4)\).

questions.prompt: Find \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c\) for \(\vec a=-4\hat i+2\hat j-4\hat k\), \(\vec b=4\hat i-\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec c=\hat i+\hat j\).
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=\begin{vmatrix}-4&2&-4\\4&-1&-1\\1&1&0\end{vmatrix}=-26\).

questions.prompt: An airplane flies on a steady course while a wind blows. The velocity of the airplane relative to the ground is
questions.explanation: Velocities add as vectors: ground velocity \(=\) velocity relative to air \(+\) velocity of the air.

questions.prompt: Two direction cosines of a vector are \(l=\frac{2}{3}\) and \(m=\frac{1}{3}\). Find \(n^2\).
Find the area of the triangle with vertices \((3, 0)\), \((-1, -4)\), \((-2, 4)\).
questions.explanation: Treat the points as \((x,y,0)\). \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=-36\hat k\), so the area is \(\tfrac12|-36|=18\).

questions.prompt: The point \(P\) divides \(\overline{AB}\) internally in the ratio \(AP:PB=1:4\), where \(A(2, 1, 3)\) and \(B(12, 11, -12)\). Find \(\overrightarrow{OP}\).
questions.explanation: \(\vec r=\dfrac{n\vec a+m\vec b}{m+n}=\dfrac{4(2, 1, 3)+1(12, 11, -12)}{5}=4\hat i+3\hat j\). (The second vector \(\vec b\) is multiplied by the first number \(m\).)

questions.prompt: A force of magnitude 20 N acts on a body and displaces it by 2 m. The angle between the force and the displacement is \(60^\circ\). Find the work done in joules.
questions.explanation: \(W=Fd\cos\theta=20\times2\times\cos60^\circ=20\) J.

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the tetrahedron with vertices \(A(-1, 0, 2)\), \(B(1, -3, -1)\), \(C(-1, 2, -1)\), \(D(0, 3, 5)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat i-3\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=2\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AD}=\hat i+3\hat j+3\hat k\); determinant \(=45\). Volume \(=\tfrac16|45|=\frac{15}{2}\).

questions.prompt: The point \(P\) divides \(\overline{AB}\) externally in the ratio \(AP:PB=1:3\), where \(A(2, -3, -1)\) and \(B(8, 1, 1)\). Find \(\overrightarrow{OP}\).
questions.explanation: External division: \(\vec r=\dfrac{m\vec b-n\vec a}{m-n}=\dfrac{1(8, 1, 1)-3(2, -3, -1)}{-2}=-\hat i-5\hat j-2\hat k\).

questions.prompt: If \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\vec a=-12\hat i-\hat j+12\hat k\) and \(\vec b=10\hat i+2\hat j-11\hat k\), find \(\cos\theta\).
Find the distance between \(P(-3, -5, -4)\) and \(Q(6, 3, 8)\).
Which unit vector is perpendicular to both \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j\) and \(\vec b=-2\hat i+3\hat j\)? (One of the two possible answers is listed.)
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\times\vec b=8\hat k\) is perpendicular to both; its magnitude is \(8\). Divide by it: \(\hat k\) (the negative of this is the other unit vector).

questions.prompt: The point \(P(-8, -2, 6)\) lies on \(\overline{AB}\) between \(A(1, 4, 3)\) and \(B(-14, -6, 8)\). Find \(AP:PB\).
questions.explanation: Compare one coordinate: \(\overrightarrow{AP}=P-A=-9\hat i-6\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AB}=-15\hat i-10\hat j+5\hat k\), so \(AP=\dfrac{3}{5}AB\), i.e. \(AP:PB=3:2\).

questions.prompt: A stone is thrown with initial speed 50 m/s at \(30^\circ\) above the horizontal. Find its horizontal velocity component (m/s).
questions.explanation: \(v_x=u\cos\phi=50\cos30^\circ=25 \sqrt{3}\) m/s (constant, since no horizontal force acts).

questions.prompt: Find the unit vector in the direction of \(\vec a=-12\hat i+12\hat j+14\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec a|=22\), so \(\hat a=\dfrac{\vec a}{|\vec a|}=\dfrac{1}{22}(-12\hat i+12\hat j+14\hat k)=-\frac{6}{11}\hat i+\frac{6}{11}\hat j+\frac{7}{11}\hat k\).

questions.prompt: The point \((-1, 8, 1)\) lies in the octant where
questions.explanation: The signs of the coordinates are \(x\) negative, \(y\) positive, \(z\) positive, so the octant is \(x<0, y>0, z>0\).

questions.prompt: Find the unit vector in the direction of \(\vec a=24\hat i-24\hat j+2\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec a|=34\), so \(\hat a=\dfrac{\vec a}{|\vec a|}=\dfrac{1}{34}(24\hat i-24\hat j+2\hat k)=\frac{12}{17}\hat i-\frac{12}{17}\hat j+\frac{1}{17}\hat k\).

questions.prompt: The point \(P(12, -10, -12)\) lies on \(\overline{AB}\) between \(A(4, 2, -4)\) and \(B(14, -13, -14)\). Find \(AP:PB\).
questions.explanation: Compare one coordinate: \(\overrightarrow{AP}=P-A=8\hat i-12\hat j-8\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AB}=10\hat i-15\hat j-10\hat k\), so \(AP=\dfrac{4}{5}AB\), i.e. \(AP:PB=4:1\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the parallelepiped with adjacent edges \(\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec c=2\hat i-2\hat j-\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Volume \(=|\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c|\). The determinant is \(2\); volume (never negative) \(=2\) cubic units.

questions.prompt: The moment of a force is largest when the angle between \(\vec r\) and \(\vec F\) is
questions.explanation: \(|\vec M|=rF\sin\theta\) is maximum when \(\sin\theta=1\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the tetrahedron with vertices \(A(2, 1, 0)\), \(B(2, 4, -2)\), \(C(0, 0, -3)\), \(D(0, 0, -1)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=3\hat j-2\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=-2\hat i-\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AD}=-2\hat i-\hat j-\hat k\); determinant \(=12\). Volume \(=\tfrac16|12|=2\).

questions.prompt: \(ABCD\) is a parallelogram (vertices in this order) with \(A(4, 2, 0)\), \(B(0, 4, -3)\), \(C(-4, 2, 0)\). Find \(D\).
questions.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other, so \(\dfrac{\vec a+\vec c}{2}=\dfrac{\vec b+\vec d}{2}\) and \(\vec d=\vec a+\vec c-\vec b=3\hat k\).

questions.prompt: A stone is thrown with initial speed 60 m/s at \(30^\circ\) above the horizontal. Find the initial vertical velocity component (m/s).
questions.explanation: \(v_y(0)=u\sin\phi=60\sin30^\circ=30\) m/s.

questions.prompt: Find the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are \(\vec a=-2\hat i+2\hat j\) and \(\vec b=-2\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Area \(=|\vec a\times\vec b|\). \(\vec a\times\vec b=2\hat i+2\hat j+6\hat k\), so area \(=\sqrt{44}=2 \sqrt{11}\).

questions.prompt: Find the projection (scalar component) of \(\vec b=2\hat i-2\hat k\) along \(\vec a=8\hat i+8\hat j-4\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Projection of \(\vec b\) along \(\vec a\) \(=\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a|}=\dfrac{24}{12}=2\).

questions.prompt: Two direction cosines of a vector are \(l=\frac{2}{7}\) and \(m=\frac{6}{7}\). Find \(n^2\).
For which value of \(t\) are \(A(4, -1, 0)\), \(B(2, 2, 1)\) and \(C(0, 5, t)\) collinear?
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=-2\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) must be parallel to it. The first two components give \(\overrightarrow{AC}=2\,\overrightarrow{AB}\), so \(t=z_A+2(1)=2\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the tetrahedron with vertices \(A(1, -1, -1)\), \(B(1, 2, 1)\), \(C(2, -1, 1)\), \(D(2, -1, -2)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=3\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=\hat i+2\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AD}=\hat i-\hat k\); determinant \(=9\). Volume \(=\tfrac16|9|=\frac{3}{2}\).

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the tetrahedron with vertices \(A(-2, 3, 2)\), \(B(-1, 3, -1)\), \(C(-2, 1, -1)\), \(D(-3, 1, 1)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=\hat i-3\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=-2\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AD}=-\hat i-2\hat j-\hat k\); determinant \(=2\). Volume \(=\tfrac16|2|=\frac{1}{3}\).

questions.prompt: The point \(P\) divides \(\overline{AB}\) internally in the ratio \(AP:PB=3:4\), where \(A(0, 0, -2)\) and \(B(7, -7, -23)\). Find \(\overrightarrow{OP}\).
questions.explanation: \(\vec r=\dfrac{n\vec a+m\vec b}{m+n}=\dfrac{4(0, 0, -2)+3(7, -7, -23)}{7}=3\hat i-3\hat j-11\hat k\). (The second vector \(\vec b\) is multiplied by the first number \(m\).)

questions.prompt: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(-2, 4, -1)\), \(B(0, 3, 0)\), \(C(4, 1, -1)\).
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{AC}=6\hat i-3\hat j\); \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=3\hat i+6\hat j\). Area \(=\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|=\tfrac12\sqrt{45}=\frac{3 \sqrt{5}}{2}\).

questions.prompt: Find the projection (scalar component) of \(\vec b=\hat i+3\hat j-4\hat k\) along \(\vec a=11\hat i-10\hat j-2\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Projection of \(\vec b\) along \(\vec a\) \(=\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a|}=\dfrac{-11}{15}=- \frac{11}{15}\).

questions.prompt: Find the position vector of the centroid of the triangle with vertices \(A(4, 0, -1)\), \(B(-2, -2, -4)\), \(C(1, 5, -4)\).
questions.explanation: The centroid divides each median in the ratio \(2:1\): \(\vec g=\dfrac{\vec a+\vec b+\vec c}{3}=\dfrac{(3, 3, -9)}{3}=\hat i+\hat j-3\hat k\).

questions.prompt: A force of 30 N is applied at a distance of 3 m from a hinge. The angle between the force and the line from the hinge to the point of application is \(30^\circ\). Find the magnitude of the moment (N m).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec M|=|\vec r||\vec F|\sin\theta=3\times30\times\sin30^\circ=45\) N m.

questions.prompt: Find the direction cosines \((l, m, n)\) of \(\vec r=2\hat i+10\hat j+11\hat k\).
Find \(|\vec r|\) when \(\vec r=6\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\).
If \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) are unit vectors with angle \(\theta\), then \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=\)
questions.explanation: \(|\vec a||\vec b|\cos\theta=\cos\theta\) when both magnitudes are \(1\).

questions.prompt: If \([\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]=-9\), find \([\vec a\ \vec c\ \vec b]\).
questions.explanation: A cyclic shift of the three vectors keeps the sign; swapping any two vectors changes the sign; a repeated vector makes the value \(0\).

questions.prompt: Find the moment of the force \(\vec F=\hat i-3\hat j-2\hat k\) acting at the point \(P(-3, 4, -2)\) about the origin.
questions.explanation: \(\vec r=\overrightarrow{OP}=P-O=-3\hat i+4\hat j-2\hat k\); \(\vec M=\vec r\times\vec F=-14\hat i-8\hat j+5\hat k\). (Order matters: \(\vec r\) first, then \(\vec F\).)

questions.prompt: A stone is thrown with initial speed 10 m/s at \(60^\circ\) above the horizontal. Find the initial vertical velocity component (m/s).
questions.explanation: \(v_y(0)=u\sin\phi=10\sin60^\circ=5 \sqrt{3}\) m/s.

questions.prompt: \(\vec a=2\hat i-4\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j-4\hat k\). The angle between them is
questions.explanation: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-14\). Positive dot product \(\Rightarrow\) acute angle, zero \(\Rightarrow\) \(90^\circ\), negative \(\Rightarrow\) obtuse.

questions.prompt: For which value of \(t\) are \(A(2, -1, -3)\), \(B(3, 0, -5)\) and \(C(1, -2, t)\) collinear?
questions.explanation: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) must be parallel to it. The first two components give \(\overrightarrow{AC}=-1\,\overrightarrow{AB}\), so \(t=z_A+-1(-2)=-1\).

questions.prompt: A force of magnitude 4 N acts on a body and displaces it by 10 m. The angle between the force and the displacement is \(60^\circ\). Find the work done in joules.
questions.explanation: \(W=Fd\cos\theta=4\times10\times\cos60^\circ=20\) J.

questions.prompt: Find the volume of the parallelepiped with adjacent edges \(\vec a=-2\hat i+2\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\vec b=-2\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec c=-\hat i+3\hat j+2\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Volume \(=|\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c|\). The determinant is \(51\); volume (never negative) \(=51\) cubic units.

questions.prompt: Find the direction cosines \((l, m, n)\) of \(\vec r=-12\hat i-6\hat j+12\hat k\).
Find \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\) if \(\vec a=-3\hat i-6\hat j+5\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-3\hat i+3\hat j+6\hat k\).
Find \(\lambda\) so that \(\vec a=2\hat i-3\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=-\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec c=-3\hat i-2\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) are coplanar.
questions.explanation: Coplanar \(\Leftrightarrow\) \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=0\). Expanding the determinant gives \(40 - 5 lam=0\), so \(\lambda=8\).

questions.prompt: Find \(\lambda\) so that \(\vec a=-2\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i-2\hat k\), \(\vec c=3\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) are coplanar.
questions.explanation: Coplanar \(\Leftrightarrow\) \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c=0\). Expanding the determinant gives \(- 2 lam - 18=0\), so \(\lambda=-9\).

questions.prompt: The triple product \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c\) is zero if two of the three vectors are
questions.explanation: Two equal rows make the determinant zero, so the vectors are coplanar.

questions.prompt: Find \(\sin\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\vec a=4\hat i+8\hat j-8\hat k\) and \(\vec b=6\hat i-6\hat j-3\hat k\).
questions.explanation: \(\sin\theta=\dfrac{|\vec a\times\vec b|}{|\vec a||\vec b|}\). \(\vec a\times\vec b=-72\hat i-36\hat j-72\hat k\), \(|\vec a|=12\), \(|\vec b|=9\), so \(\sin\theta=1\).

questions.prompt: Find the moment of the force \(\vec F=\hat i-4\hat j+4\hat k\) acting at the point \(P(-3, 4, -2)\) about the origin.
questions.explanation: \(\vec r=\overrightarrow{OP}=P-O=-3\hat i+4\hat j-2\hat k\); \(\vec M=\vec r\times\vec F=8\hat i+10\hat j+8\hat k\). (Order matters: \(\vec r\) first, then \(\vec F\).)

questions.prompt: If \(\vec a=-\hat i-5\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=2\hat i-3\hat j+5\hat k\), find \(2\vec a+2\vec b\).
questions.explanation: Multiply component by component then add: \(2(-1, -5, 2)+2(2, -3, 5)=2\hat i-16\hat j+14\hat k\).

questions.prompt: Find \(\lambda\) so that \(\vec a=2\hat i+3\hat j-4\hat k\) is parallel to \(\vec b=6\hat i+9\hat j+\lambda\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Parallel means \(\vec b=k\vec a\), i.e. equal ratios of components. From the first component \(k=\dfrac{6}{2}=3\), so \(\lambda=k\cdot(-4)=-12\).

questions.prompt: Find the projection (scalar component) of \(\vec b=-2\hat i-\hat j-\hat k\) along \(\vec a=4\hat i-6\hat j-12\hat k\).
questions.explanation: Projection of \(\vec b\) along \(\vec a\) \(=\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a|}=\dfrac{10}{14}=\frac{5}{7}\).

questions.prompt: The point \((5, -6, 1)\) lies in the octant where
questions.explanation: The signs of the coordinates are \(x\) positive, \(y\) negative, \(z\) positive, so the octant is \(x>0, y<0, z>0\).

questions.prompt: A vector makes angles \(90^\circ\) and \(30^\circ\) with the \(x\)- and \(y\)-axes. Find the angle it makes with the \(z\)-axis (acute).
questions.explanation: \(\cos^2\alpha+\cos^2\beta+\cos^2\gamma=1\Rightarrow\cos^2\gamma=1-\cos^290^\circ-\cos^230^\circ=\frac{1}{4}\), so \(\gamma=60^\circ\).

questions.prompt: A force of 20 N is applied at a distance of 2 m from a hinge. The angle between the force and the line from the hinge to the point of application is \(150^\circ\). Find the magnitude of the moment (N m).
questions.explanation: \(|\vec M|=|\vec r||\vec F|\sin\theta=2\times20\times\sin150^\circ=20\) N m.

questions.explanation: If \(l:m:n=a:b:c\) then \(a,b,c\) are direction ratios; the components of the vector are one example.
